Berkley Syndicate 1967 experienced a prior year adverse development (strengthening) of $5.113 million in 2018, representing 2.08% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was explicitly stated as "prior accident year adverse development of claims incurred". The report also notes losses from closed years (2009-2015) and the 2016 year of account, partly driven by natural catastrophe events such as Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria. The 2017 underwriting year was also significantly affected by these hurricanes, Mexican earthquakes, and California wildfires, contributing to a cumulative loss for that year. The report does not provide a breakdown of the $5.113 million by specific lines of business or individual prior events.

gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2018 with gross claims outstanding of 246.086 million (USD). During the calendar year there was an adverse prior-accident-year development of 5.1 million (USD), representing a ~2.07% adverse movement versus opening gross reserves. Management attributes much of the prior year deterioration to catastrophe and large loss activity experienced in 2017 (notably Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, Mexican earthquakes and California wildfires) and to adverse prior-year claims development on closed years. No reliable per-line-of-business prior-year reserve breakdown is provided.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: All amounts are reported in the syndicate's functional currency (USD). Opening gross claims outstanding (246,086) and the explicit prior-accident-year adverse development ($5.1m) are taken verbatim from the Technical Provisions note and the Claims Development note. No explicit aggregate prior-year reserve movement broken down by line of business is provided. The gross premium mix was taken from the Managing Agent's managed class gross premium table (2018 amounts) and percentages are calculated against total gross premium written (254.5). No RITC line item is evident; the claims development triangle was used only to corroborate the explicit prior-year statement. Lob-level prior year reserve movements are not disclosed, so lob_movements are left empty.
